violation_type.title: Doors to Restroom - Employee in Restroom With Children Under 5 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4421(2)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Doors to Restroom - Employee in Restroom With Children Under 5 Years of Age
violation_type.typical_finding: I observed a one child age 4 years old in the bathroom alone with the door closed without an adult present.

finding_variants.text: I observed a one child age 4 years old in the bathroom alone with the door closed without an adult present.
During the investigation it was determined a child was able to lock the bathroom door from the inside and an adult was not in the area with the child.
Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation that an employee left a child in the restroom alone.
